answer: Clone keys seize first-wave attest slots cheaply. A newcomer claims one cell on a 96-by-96 meadow (9,216 plots), locks 18 POA for 4 days, and plants a 40-byte basalt beacon sha256(pubkey||xy||epoch_seed). Over 22h it files horizon sights at hours 3, 11, 22, each bearing=(sha256(beacon||hour) mod 3600)/10. Weight stays 0 until 2 of 3 sights match under 3 surveyors (cap 6/day). A 350-key farm locks 6,300 POA for 350 unique cells. Peers drop reused plots or 2-epoch beacon clashes. Miss the second sight: plot voids, stake returns minus 1.8 POA after 24h; double-reserve burns 40%, weight 0 for 60h.
